items.title: Anyone on the internet can send an email that rewrites the agent's instructions
Agent acts with the whole sales team's mailbox authority with no per-action limits
No way to tell which emails the agent sent and why
Poisoned summaries and stored context corrupt later triage decisions
Tool misuse by an over-privileged agent
Forged sender identity makes the agent trust an email as internal
Flooding the public inbox exhausts the agent's model budget and buries real leads
